title: DER Aggregation Operating Procedure v3.2
summary: Internal operating procedure covering DER registration, telemetry, and market offer submission.
full_text: This procedure governs how Verdant Grid's DER aggregation team registers resources with MISO, maintains telemetry, and submits market offers. See §4 for registration workflow.

title: Draft Tariff Filing — DER Aggregation Compliance (2026 Q4)
summary: Draft Verdant Grid tariff filing responding to MISO's Order 2222 compliance plan.
full_text: Draft filing addresses aggregator registration lead time, telemetry obligations, and minimum size interoperability.

title: Verdant Grid MISO DER Aggregation Compliance Plan v2.1
summary: Verdant's internal policy document describing how its DER aggregation program complies with FERC Order 2222 and MISO's compliance filing.
full_text: This plan covers registration, telemetry, settlement, and dispute-handling for Verdant's DER aggregation program against MISO's Order 2222 compliance filing. Owners: Market Operations lead + Legal lead.

title: DER Aggregation Settlement Procedure v1.0
summary: Internal procedure for receiving MISO settlement payments on DER aggregation offers and remitting customer shares.
full_text: Market-ops settlement team runs this procedure after each MISO settlement cycle. Covers DER-level allocation, customer remittance, and dispute handling.

title: DER Participant Communication Template
summary: Outbound communication template used to notify DER aggregation participants of program changes, dispatch events, and settlement timing.
full_text: Fill-in template for customer-facing comms about DER aggregation program status, dispatch pre-notification, and settlement remittance.
